meta.name: linkedin-post-writer
meta.description: Draft a new LinkedIn post from scratch using one of 20 2026 hook formulas (anaphora, R.I.P., time-anchor, curiosity-gap, contrarian, controlled A/B, false-binary, and more) plus a founders-edition angle library, picked by engagement goal (comments, reposts, likes, saves). Runs the humanizer pass and schedules via Publora on approval. Use to write a post, find a hook or proven format, or get founder-specific angles. Not for reviewing existing drafts (use linkedin-humanizer --mode audit).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把零散想法写成一条抓眼球的 LinkedIn 帖,并按时发布
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常想发 LinkedIn 却卡在开头,还得手动排发布时间。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a rough idea into a scroll-stopping LinkedIn post and schedule it.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to post on LinkedIn but get stuck on the opening line.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先按你要的互动目标(评论、转发、点赞、收藏)从钩子公式库里挑一个,帮你从零起草一条 LinkedIn 帖子,过一遍去 AI 味的检查,经你同意后通过 Publora 排期发布。
howto.when: 当你说「帮我写一条关于 X 的 LinkedIn 帖子」、需要一个钩子或现成格式、想要创始人视角时触发;它不负责审阅已有草稿。

say.text: 帮我写一条 LinkedIn 帖子,目标是拿到更多评论
say.note: 会先按目标推荐 2-3 个公式让你挑

say.text: 我有个话题:远程团队管理,给我一个钩子
say.note: 会给出钩子和结构骨架

say.text: 换成长文,1500-1900 字符,目标是收藏
say.note: 按长度重写并给出字符数

howto.what_en: After install, Claude picks a hook formula matched to your goal (comments, reposts, likes, saves), drafts a LinkedIn post from scratch, runs a humanizer pass, and schedules it via Publora once you approve.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask it to write a LinkedIn post about a topic, need a hook or a proven format, or want founder-specific angles. It is not for reviewing existing drafts.

say_en.text: Write me a LinkedIn post aimed at getting more comments
say_en.note: It suggests 2-3 formulas to pick from

say_en.text: My topic is remote team management - give me a hook
say_en.note: Returns a hook and a skeleton

say_en.text: Make it long form, 1500-1900 chars, goal: saves
say_en.note: Rewrites to length and shows char count
